newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Maori election enrolment up 10 pct from 1993.
newsitem.headline: NZ Maori election enrolment up 10 pct from 1993.

text.p: Maori election enrolment had increased by 10 percent over three years ago when the electoral rolls closed for printing on September 12, the Electoral Enrolment Centre said on Monday.
This was despite a fall in overall enrolment of nearly three percent.
Figures released by the centre showed 25,210 more Maori had enrolled on either the general or Maori electoral rolls for this election than enrolled for the 1993 election.
At present there are five seats to be allocated to Maori MPs in the general election on October 12. This can change in future elections depending on the number of Maori.
